name: Dramify – AMD to Dram for WooCommerce
author: Arthur Virabyan

sections.description:
Dramify replaces the “AMD” currency label in WooCommerce with “դրամ”, “դր.”, “֏”, or any custom text you define. Built specifically for Armenian online stores using WooCommerce.

Key Features in 1.1.0:
* Quick Presets & Custom Label: Easily switch between դրամ, դր., ֏, AMD, or any custom text in one click.
* Automatic Space Formatting: Ensures a clean non-breaking space between the price amount and the currency symbol (e.g., 15,000 դրամ instead of 15,000դրամ).
* Zero Decimals Option: Hide .00 decimals for Armenian Dram prices with a single checkbox.
* Multilingual Currency Labels: Automatically display դրամ on Armenian (hy), драм on Russian (ru), and AMD on English (en) pages (works with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, and native WordPress locales).
* Live Price Preview: Real-time preview of your storefront price format directly in the admin settings.
* WooCommerce HPOS & Blocks Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
* Developer-Friendly Hooks: Includes dramify_filter_currency_name and dramify_filter_currency_symbol filters.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/dramify directory, or install it directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Click Settings on the plugin row or go to Settings > Dramify to configure your currency display.
sections.faq:
Can I set any custom label instead of “դրամ”?

Yes, you can pick one of the built-in presets (դրամ, դր., ֏, AMD) or type any custom text on the settings page.

Does it support multilingual stores (Armenian, Russian, English)?

Yes! Enable the Multilingual Labels option in Settings > Dramify to specify separate currency labels for Armenian (hy), Russian (ru), and English (en).

How do I remove `.00` decimals from AMD prices?

Enable the Hide decimals (.00) for AMD prices checkbox in Settings > Dramify.

Is Dramify compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, Dramify declares full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: One-click presets (դրամ, դր., ֏, AMD) on the settings page.
  • New: Live Price Preview in the admin settings page.
  • New: Option to automatically add a space between the price and currency label.
  • New: Option to hide .00 decimals for AMD prices.
  • New: Multilingual currency label support for Armenian (hy), Russian (ru), and English (en).
  • New: Quick “Settings” link in the WordPress Plugins list.
  • New: Declared compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (custom_order_tables) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
  • New: Added Requires Plugins: woocommerce header.
  • Fix: Prevent empty currency label if settings are saved with a blank input.

1.0.0

  • Initial release – replaces AMD with “դրամ” or custom label.
